params.prompt: Design one original premium app icon for LA GRILLA, a native iPhone music instrument in 2026. Full square 1024x1024 opaque image, no phone mockup and no outer rounded-square border because iOS supplies the mask. A single bold, precise, flat graphic mark centered within the middle 68% of the square. The unique visual idea is a luminous vertical musical playhead crossing three horizontal rhythmic score lanes: one confident acid-pear #D8F780 vertical stroke and three short warm-ivory #F1F2E8 horizontal lane segments, punctuated by a few deliberate amber #EDBF7A note steps. The crossing and carefully staggered gaps create a memorable architectural grid glyph, with balance, asymmetry and strong negative space. Matte graphite #111510 background, uniform and quiet. The logo must read as one coherent musical-grid symbol at 48 pixels, with chunky consistent geometry, flat solid colors, subtly softened geometric corners and generous breathing room. Sophisticated, distinctive, minimal, exact, contemporary Swiss-inspired instrument design. No letters, no wordmark, no music-note clip art, no play triangle, no equalizer bars, no nine-pill keypad, no gradients, no 3D, no metallic texture, no glow, no shadows, no thin hairlines, no decorative frame. This should feel like an original independent music tool, not a stock audio icon. Only the finished square icon.
